## History

Spencer was involved in the orphan adoption process that led to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the requested boy. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later visited Spencer at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) Cove alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to investigate how the mix-up had occurred. During the visit, it was revealed that Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) was interested in taking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a domestic helper, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to delay a final decision and take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alexander-spencer--spencer.md)

[Alexander Spencer](../character/alexander-spencer.md) is the husband of Spencer, with their marriage established prior to the events of the first volume. Their bond represents a long-standing domestic partnership.

- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is Spencer's daughter. Spencer resides with her family at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) Cove, where she manages household affairs and interactions with visiting neighbors like [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Parent of — daughter  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
